Tagline: Co op disasters and bad decisions.

assets.prompt: A browser-window screenshot showing THREE fictional gaming-channel thumbnail grids stacked as horizontal rows, each row a strip of four loud YouTube-style gaming thumbnails, invented channel names beside each row ('BLASTZONE', 'GremlinCore', 'NOCLIP NIGHTS' — all fictional, no real logos or brands). Every thumbnail is maximally loud in the comedy-gaming style: a large exaggerated cartoon reaction face pushed to one side, a saturated NEON COLOUR WASH laid over the whole image, huge chunky ALL-CAPS title text with a thick contrasting outline and an outer glow, bright arrows and circles pointing at things, big yellow numbers, drop shadows behind everything. Generic invented avatars, nonsense placeholder title words, a neutral light-grey browser chrome around the grids. The kind of screengrab a creator saves and says 'this is the energy I want'. No real people, no real trademarks. CRITICAL: absolutely no real brand names, logos, wordmarks, trademarks or trade dress anywhere in the frame — the browser chrome, tabs, address bar, favicons and any on-thumbnail marks must be BLANK and generic with NO YouTube logo, NO red play-button glyph, NO 'YouTube' wordmark, and no other real platform or company mark (no Google, Chrome, Twitch, TikTok, Discord, etc.); no famous-brand look-alikes; the browser window is a plain neutral unbranded chrome and the only brand permitted anywhere is the fictional channel STATIC FOX (use only the invented channel names given: BLASTZONE, GremlinCore, NOCLIP NIGHTS); no burned-in real person names or captions.
